metadata.description: Wecko's agent skills and plugins (wecko.ai): one plugin per bucket, install only what you need.

plugins.name: wecko-engineering
plugins.description: Agent orchestration (/office), prompt refinement with a local LLM (/promptfit), a vision bridge for text-only models, and local LLM sizing guides.

plugins.name: wecko-productivity
plugins.description: Session wrap-up (/closing): persist memory, verify what shipped, list loose ends. Session handoff (/continue): stop cleanly when the context fills up and get a prompt to resume in a fresh session.

plugins.name: wecko-video
plugins.description: Video post-production: YouTube audio mastering and word-by-word karaoke captions.

plugins.name: wecko-agent-notify
plugins.description: Phone ping (ntfy, Telegram, any command) when Claude Code is really done: waits for background agents, teammates and shells, and stays quiet while you are at the Mac.
